notes.title: First Storebound Patch
notes.notes:
Hello shoppers!

Thank you to everyone who has played the demo for Storebound so far. We are looking over all of the feedback we have received to improve the game, starting with a new patch that is out right now!

If you haven't already, please consider leaving a review for the Storebound demo!

It really does help us out, and more importantly we are reading every review to help us improve the game. You can leave your review on the Storebound demo page here:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4011020/Storebound_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]Also, consider joining the Discord where you can meet others to play with and ask the devs your questions.

Storebound Discord

Here's what we fixed in our first patch:
• Many soft-locks have been fixed. Please continue to report these so we can fix them ASAP!
• Improved clarity of objectives and guidance in the environment to improve gameplay flow.
• Scourge has been tuned to be slightly less aggressive in the last portion of the demo.
• An invite friends button has been added to the pause menu.
• Fixed the issue that made players get stuck inside their own shoulder.

Currently Unresolved Issues:
• Voice Chat: We have identified problems with in-game voice chat and are working on a fix.
• There is an issue where after all party members die the game freezes, needing a restart. We are still working on a fix.

Please continue to report issues here or on our Discord.

Thank you again to everyone who has played!

See you next time, shoppers.
Nikko
Community Manager
